title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasining “Avtomobil yo‘llari to‘g‘risida”gi Qonuni (O‘RQ-1162-son, 05.08.2026)
abs: 2026-yil 5-avgustda imzolangan yangi tahrirdagi qonun. Avtomobil yo‘llarini umumiy foydalanishdagi, ichki (shahar va aholi punktlari ko‘chalari) va xo‘jalik yo‘llariga ajratadi, Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasini sohadagi maxsus vakolatli organ sifatida belgilaydi va pulli yo‘llarni tashkil etish tartibini, jumladan muqobil bepul yo‘l bo‘lishi shartini mustahkamlaydi. Havola qonun haqidagi rasmiy axborotga olib boradi; to‘liq matn Lex.uz milliy bazasida.

title: SHNQ 2.05.02-23 “Avtomobil yo‘llari. Loyihalash talablari” shaharsozlik normalari va qoidalari
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
org: Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
abs: Vazirning 2024-yil 23-avgustdagi 01/2-61-son buyrug‘i bilan tasdiqlangan normalar. Yangi qurilayotgan, ta’mirlanadigan va rekonstruksiya qilinadigan umumiy foydalanishdagi hamda shaharcha, qishloq, ovul va xo‘jalik avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalashga qo‘yiladigan talablarni belgilaydi; bog‘liq standartlar (ko‘priklar, yoritish, asfaltbeton qorishmalari) ro‘yxatini o‘z ichiga oladi.

title: ShNQ 2.05.03-22 «Ko‘priklar va quvurlar» shaharsozlik normalari va qoidalariga qo‘shimchalar kiritish to‘g‘risida (17-son, 23.01.2024)
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
org: Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
abs: Avtomobil yo‘llaridagi ko‘priklar va suv o‘tkazuvchi quvurlarni loyihalash normalariga yangi 5¹-bob qo‘shilgan buyruq. Sun’iy inshootlar bo‘yicha amaldagi me’yoriy bazani kuzatib borish uchun asosiy manba.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llarini qurish, rekonstruksiya qilish, ta’mirlash va ulardan foydalanish ishlarini tashkil etish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 901-son qarori, 30.12.2024)
abs: PQ-330 qaroriga muvofiq qabul qilingan qaror. Bajarilgan ishlarni hajm uslubida hisobga olish tartibi, avtomobil yo‘llarini ta’mirlash va saqlash ishlari tasnifi, tugallangan obyektlarni qabul qilish hamda yo‘llardagi tabiiy va texnogen favqulodda vaziyatlar oqibatlarini bartaraf etish tartibini belgilovchi ilovalarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

title: Yo‘l xo‘jaligi sohasini yanada takomillashtirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PQ-330-son qarori, 10.10.2023)
abs: Yo‘l xo‘jaligi tizimini isloh qilishga qaratilgan qaror; 2023-yil 16-oktabrdan kuchga kirgan. Keyingi hukumat qarorlari, jumladan ishlarni tashkil etish tartibi shu hujjat asosida ishlab chiqilgan.

title: Sement-beton qoplamali avtomobil yo‘llari tarmog‘ini kengaytirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (PQ-249-son qarori, 18.05.2022)
abs: Davlat ahamiyatidagi yo‘llarda sement-beton qoplamalarni kengaytirishga qaratilgan Prezident qarori. Qattiq qoplamali yo‘llar bo‘yicha tadqiqot va loyiha ishlari uchun asosiy siyosiy-huquqiy manba.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasining “Avtomobil yo‘llari to‘g‘risida”gi Qonuni (653-XII-son, 03.07.1992)
abs: Mustaqillikdan keyin qabul qilingan birinchi yo‘l qonuni: yo‘llarni umumiy foydalanishdagi va korxonalarga qarashli turlarga ajratgan, xalqaro ahamiyatdagi yo‘llar tushunchasini kiritgan. 2007-yil 2-oktabrdagi O‘RQ-117 qonuni bilan kuchini yo‘qotgan; tarixiy-huquqiy manba sifatida saqlanadi.

title: ShNQ 2.05.02-07 “Avtomobil yo‘llari” (03.07.2008)
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Davlat arxitektura va qurilish qo‘mitasi
abs: Uzoq yillar amalda bo‘lgan avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash normalari; yo‘l toifalari, hisobiy tezliklar va harakat jadalligiga oid asosiy parametrlarni belgilagan. Lex.uz ma’lumotiga ko‘ra 2024-yil 14-oktabrdan kuchini yo‘qotgan.

title: СНиП 2.05.02-85 «Автомобильные дороги»
abs: Sovet davri avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash normalari (Gosstroyning 1985-yil 17-dekabrdagi 233-son qarori). Yo‘l toifalari, yo‘l poyi va yo‘l to‘shamasi qatlamlari bo‘yicha talablar keyingi milliy normalarga asos bo‘lgan; tarixiy taqqoslash uchun muhim.

title: O‘zbekiston avtomobil yo‘llari infratuzilmasining hududiy tarkibidagi o‘zgarishlar
abs: FarDU ilmiy xabarlari, 2025, 31-jild, 3-son. Maqolada respublika yo‘l tarmog‘ining hududlar bo‘yicha joylashuvi, xalqaro va davlat ahamiyatidagi yo‘nalishlar tahlil qilinib, hududiy tarkibni takomillashtirish bo‘yicha takliflar berilgan.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llarini karst jarayonlari rivojlangan joylarda loyihalashning o‘ziga xosligi
abs: “Yangi O‘zbekistonda tabiiy va ijtimoiy-gumanitar fanlar” respublika konferensiyasi materiallari (2-jild, 3-son, 30–34-betlar). Karst jarayonlari rivojlangan hududlarda yo‘l trassasini tanlash va yo‘l poyini loyihalash xususiyatlari ko‘rib chiqilgan. Ochiq kirish (Zenodo).

title: Avtomobil yo‘llari yo‘l poyi ko‘tarmasining loyihalash me’yoriy ko‘rsatkichlarini takomillashtirish (Samarqand viloyati misolida)
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 05.09.02 – “Geotexnika” ixtisosligi. Himoya TDTU huzuridagi PhD.10/2025.27.12.T.01.05 Ilmiy kengashida 2026-yil 15-iyulda belgilangan. Havola rasmiy himoya e’loniga olib boradi; avtoreferat va dissertatsiya matni muallif roziligi bilan qo‘shilishi mumkin.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llari holatini ko‘rsatuvchi ochiq elektron xarita
abs: Transport vazirligi huzuridagi Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasining rasmiy sahifasidagi interaktiv xarita: umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llarning holati bo‘yicha ochiq ma’lumotlar. Dala tadqiqotlari va loyiha ishlarida vizual manba sifatida foydalanish mumkin.

title: Uzbekistan: Building Blocks for Integrated Transport and Logistics Sector Development
abs: World Bank policy paper reviewing Uzbekistan's transport and logistics sector and setting out the institutional and policy building blocks for an integrated, multimodal development approach, including the role of roads within the national logistics system.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston: integratsiyalashgan transport va logistika sohasini rivojlantirishning asosiy tamoyillari
uz.ab: Jahon bankining siyosiy hujjati. O‘zbekiston transport va logistika sohasini tahlil qilib, ko‘p turli transportni birgalikda rivojlantirish uchun zarur institutsional va siyosiy asoslarni, jumladan avtomobil yo‘llarining milliy logistika tizimidagi o‘rnini ko‘rsatib beradi.

title: Republic of Uzbekistan: Road Subsector Development Strategy and Action Plan (TA 9987-UZB)
abs: Technical assistance consultant's report prepared for the Committee for Roads and ADB (April 2021). Sets out a strategy and action plan for the republican road network covering institutions, funding, asset management, design standards, network management, investment priorities and monitoring.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi: avtomobil yo‘llari kichik sohasini rivojlantirish strategiyasi va harakatlar rejasi
uz.ab: Osiyo taraqqiyot banki texnik ko‘mak loyihasi doirasida Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasi uchun tayyorlangan hisobot (2021-yil aprel). Respublika yo‘l tarmog‘i bo‘yicha institutlar, moliyalashtirish, aktivlarni boshqarish, loyihalash standartlari, investitsiya ustuvorliklari va monitoringni qamrab olgan strategiya va reja.

title: Global Status Report on Road Safety 2023
abs: WHO's fifth global report on road safety. Estimates annual road traffic deaths at 1.19 million, reviews progress during the 2011–2020 Decade of Action and sets the baseline for the 2021–2030 target of halving deaths and injuries; country profiles, including Uzbekistan, accompany the report.

uz.t: Yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi holati bo‘yicha global hisobot, 2023
uz.ab: JSSTning yo‘l xavfsizligi bo‘yicha beshinchi global hisoboti. Yo‘l-transport hodisalarida yiliga 1,19 million kishi halok bo‘lishini baholaydi, 2011–2020 yillardagi Harakatlar o‘n yilligi natijalarini sarhisob qiladi va 2030 yilgacha o‘lim va jarohatlarni ikki baravar kamaytirish maqsadi uchun boshlang‘ich ko‘rsatkichlarni belgilaydi. Mamlakatlar, jumladan O‘zbekiston profillari ilova qilingan.

title: The Long-Term Pavement Performance Program (FHWA-HRT-15-049)
abs: Comprehensive FHWA report on the Long-Term Pavement Performance programme: its history since the Strategic Highway Research Program, test-section experiments, data collection and the main findings on how design, materials, traffic and climate affect pavement performance.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamalarining uzoq muddatli ishlash dasturi (LTPP)
uz.ab: AQSh Federal avtomobil yo‘llari ma’muriyatining LTPP dasturi bo‘yicha keng qamrovli hisoboti: tajriba uchastkalari, ma’lumotlar yig‘ish usullari hamda loyiha, materiallar, transport yuklamasi va iqlim qoplamaning ishlashiga qanday ta’sir qilishi haqidagi asosiy xulosalar.

title: Regional Roads Development Project (P146334) — Project Appraisal Document (PAD1270)
abs: Appraisal document for a proposed IDA credit of SDR 145 million (US$200 million) to rehabilitate regional roads in Uzbekistan. Covers project design, results framework and monitoring (including IRI and travel-speed indicators), road sector governance review, safeguards and implementation arrangements.

uz.t: Mintaqaviy yo‘llarni rivojlantirish loyihasi (P146334) — loyihani baholash hujjati
uz.ab: O‘zbekistonda mintaqaviy yo‘llarni tiklash uchun 145 mln SDR (200 mln AQSh dollari) miqdoridagi XTA krediti bo‘yicha Jahon banki baholash hujjati. Loyiha tuzilmasi, natijalar ko‘rsatkichlari (IRI va harakat tezligi), yo‘l sohasini boshqarishni ko‘rib chiqish va amalga oshirish tartibini o‘z ichiga oladi.

title: Connectivity and Transport Sector Improvement Project (P509487) — Project Information Document
abs: Project information document for a World Bank operation (approved March 2026) aiming to improve road connectivity, safety and climate resilience in Surkhandarya region and to strengthen transport sector institutions in Uzbekistan; summarises sector context and past Bank support, including the first road PPP.

uz.t: Transport bog‘liqligi va sohasini takomillashtirish loyihasi (P509487) — loyiha haqida ma’lumot hujjati
uz.ab: Jahon bankining 2026-yil martida ma’qullangan loyihasi: Surxondaryo viloyatida yo‘l bog‘liqligi, xavfsizligi va iqlimga chidamliligini oshirish hamda transport sohasi institutlarini mustahkamlash. Soha holati va bankning avvalgi ko‘magi, jumladan yo‘l sohasidagi birinchi DXSh loyihasi qisqacha bayon etilgan.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 1: Road Safety Audit
abs: Practical reference for the road safety audit process in CAREC countries (March 2018): what an audit is, its objectives, how to manage and carry it out at each project stage, with checklists. Endorsed by CAREC members as an integral part of road project planning, design and construction.

uz.t: CAREC yo‘l xavfsizligi muhandisligi qo‘llanmasi 1: Yo‘l xavfsizligi auditi
uz.ab: CAREC mamlakatlarida yo‘l xavfsizligi auditini o‘tkazish bo‘yicha amaliy qo‘llanma (2018-yil mart): audit nima, uning maqsadlari, loyihaning har bir bosqichida uni tashkil etish va o‘tkazish tartibi, tekshiruv varaqalari bilan.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 2: Safer Road Works
abs: Good-practice guidance for safe road worksites on CAREC roads (March 2018), protecting both road users and workers. Intended as the main reference for road works in contract documents of CAREC road projects.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 2: Yo‘l ishlarini xavfsiz tashkil etish
uz.ab: CAREC yo‘llarida ish olib boriladigan uchastkalarni yo‘l harakati ishtirokchilari va ishchilar uchun xavfsiz tashkil etish bo‘yicha ilg‘or tajriba (2018-yil mart). CAREC loyihalari shartnoma hujjatlarida asosiy manba sifatida tavsiya etiladi.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 3: Roadside Hazard Management
abs: Manual on managing roadside hazards (April 2018): identifying dangerous roadside objects, treatment options, the three groups of safety barriers and safer roadside furniture.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 3: Yo‘l yoqasidagi xavflarni boshqarish
uz.ab: Yo‘l yoqasidagi xavfli obyektlarni aniqlash va bartaraf etish, to‘siqlarning uch guruhi va xavfsiz yo‘l jihozlari bo‘yicha qo‘llanma (2018-yil aprel).

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 4: Pedestrian Safety
abs: Manual on providing safer pedestrian facilities in CAREC countries (February 2021), focusing on physical road infrastructure and planning for pedestrian safety. Also available in Russian on the CAREC website.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 4: Piyodalar xavfsizligi
uz.ab: CAREC mamlakatlarida piyodalar uchun xavfsiz infratuzilmani loyihalash va rejalashtirish bo‘yicha qo‘llanma (2021-yil fevral). CAREC saytida rus tilidagi versiyasi ham mavjud.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 6: Identifying, Investigating, and Treating Blackspots
abs: Guidance for engineers, police and planners (May 2024) on finding high-crash locations, investigating them and choosing treatments, and on prioritising funding toward sites where treatment is most cost-effective.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 6: Avariya o‘choqlarini aniqlash, tekshirish va bartaraf etish
uz.ab: Muhandislar, politsiya va rejalashtiruvchilar uchun qo‘llanma (2024-yil may): YTH ko‘p sodir bo‘ladigan joylarni aniqlash, tekshirish, chora tanlash va mablag‘ni eng samarali uchastkalarga yo‘naltirish.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 7: Why and How to Manage Speed
abs: Manual (August 2024) on the role of speed in road safety in CAREC countries: setting appropriate speed limits and operating speeds, road design and engineering measures, vehicle technology and enforcement, with recommendations for road authorities.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 7: Tezlikni nima uchun va qanday boshqarish kerak
uz.ab: CAREC mamlakatlarida tezlikning yo‘l xavfsizligidagi o‘rni haqida qo‘llanma (2024-yil avgust): tezlik chegaralarini belgilash, yo‘l loyihalash va muhandislik choralari, transport vositalari texnologiyalari va nazorat bo‘yicha tavsiyalar.

title: PIARC Road Safety Manual: A manual for practitioners and decision makers on implementing Safe System infrastructure (2nd edition)
abs: Free online manual of the World Road Association, first released in 2015 and updated in 2019, to help countries at any stage of infrastructure development meet road safety objectives. Three parts, downloadable by chapter; available in English, French and Spanish.

uz.t: PIARC yo‘l xavfsizligi qo‘llanmasi: “Xavfsiz tizim” infratuzilmasini joriy etish bo‘yicha amaliyotchilar va qaror qabul qiluvchilar uchun qo‘llanma
uz.ab: Jahon yo‘l assotsiatsiyasining bepul onlayn qo‘llanmasi (2015, 2019-yilda yangilangan). Infratuzilma rivojlanishining istalgan bosqichidagi mamlakatlarga yo‘l xavfsizligi maqsadlariga erishishda yordam beradi; boblar bo‘yicha yuklab olinadi.

title: Overseas Road Note 31: A Guide to the Structural Design of Bitumen-Surfaced Roads in Tropical and Sub-Tropical Countries (4th edition)
abs: Classic TRL guide to the structural design of new bitumen-surfaced roads carrying up to 30 million equivalent standard axles in hot climates: traffic estimation, subgrade assessment, drainage, materials and a pavement design catalogue. A 5th edition (Road Note 31) was published in 2022.

uz.t: Road Note 31: Issiq iqlimli mamlakatlarda bitum qoplamali yo‘llarni konstruktiv loyihalash bo‘yicha qo‘llanma (4-nashr)
uz.ab: TRLning issiq iqlim sharoitida 30 mln ekvivalent standart o‘qgacha yuklama ko‘taradigan yangi bitum qoplamali yo‘llarni loyihalash bo‘yicha mumtoz qo‘llanmasi: transport oqimini baholash, grunt asos, drenaj, materiallar va qoplama konstruksiyalari katalogi. O‘zbekistonning issiq yozi uchun ayniqsa dolzarb; 2022-yilda 5-nashri chiqqan.

title: NCHRP Report 673: A Manual for Design of Hot-Mix Asphalt with Commentary
abs: Manual incorporating advances in materials characterisation and hot-mix asphalt mix design technology, with commentary; companion spreadsheet tool and training materials available. Free PDF download from the National Academies Press.

uz.t: NCHRP 673-hisobot: Issiq asfaltbeton aralashmalarini loyihalash bo‘yicha sharhli qo‘llanma
uz.ab: Materiallarni tavsiflash va asfaltbeton aralashmalarini loyihalash texnologiyasidagi yutuqlarni jamlagan qo‘llanma; hisob-kitob jadvali va o‘quv materiallari ilova qilingan. Milliy akademiyalar nashriyotidan bepul PDF.

title: The Design of Bitumen-Surfaced Roads in Tropical and Sub-Tropical Countries — the 4th Edition of Overseas Road Note 31
abs: Article in the TRL Annual Review 1994 (pp. 59–64) introducing the 4th edition of Overseas Road Note 31 and its approach to pavement base, subgrade, seal coats and maintenance costs in hot climates. Indexed in the TRID international database.

uz.t: Issiq iqlimli mamlakatlarda bitum qoplamali yo‘llarni loyihalash — Road Note 31 ning 4-nashri
uz.ab: TRL yillik sharhida (1994, 59–64-betlar) chop etilgan maqola: Road Note 31 4-nashrining asos qatlam, grunt, sirt ishlov berish va ta’mirlash xarajatlariga yondashuvi. TRID xalqaro bazasida indekslangan.

title: Karayolu Teknik Şartnamesi (KTŞ 2023)
abs: Turkey's General Directorate of Highways road technical specification, revised to current national and international standards and put into force on 27.12.2023. The electronic edition is available through the KGM website (Technical Publications) and e-Government. The linked KGM R&D activity report describes the revision.

uz.t: Turkiya avtomobil yo‘llari texnik shartnomasi (KTŞ 2023)
uz.ab: Turkiya Avtomobil yo‘llari bosh boshqarmasining yo‘l qurilishi texnik shartlari; amaldagi milliy va xalqaro standartlar asosida qayta ishlanib, 2023-yil 27-dekabrdan kuchga kirgan. Elektron nashri KGM saytidagi “Texnik nashrlar” bo‘limida. Havola qayta ishlash haqidagi KGM hisobotiga olib boradi.

title: Karayolu Trafik İşaretleme Standartları
abs: KGM standard for road traffic signs and markings, issued under the Highway Traffic Law and the presidential decree on agency organisation. Original in Turkish.

uz.t: Turkiya: yo‘l harakatini belgilash standartlari
uz.ab: KGM tomonidan yo‘l belgilari va yotiq chiziqlar bo‘yicha qabul qilingan standart. Asl matni turk tilida.

title: Road Structure Ordinance (Government Ordinance No. 320 of 29 October 1970)
authors: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT)
abs: Japan's general technical standard for road structure: road classification, design vehicles, cross-section elements, design speed, alignment, bridges (design vehicle load 245 kN) and tunnels. Official English text published by MLIT; revised several times, most recently for bicycle traffic zones (2019).

uz.t: Yaponiya: Yo‘l konstruksiyasi to‘g‘risidagi hukumat farmoni (№320, 1970)
uz.ab: Yaponiyada yo‘llarni loyihalashning asosiy texnik me’yori: yo‘l toifalari, hisobiy transport vositalari, ko‘ndalang kesim elementlari, hisobiy tezlik, trassa, ko‘priklar (hisobiy yuklama 245 kN) va tunnellar. MLIT rasmiy inglizcha matni; bir necha bor yangilangan, oxirgisi velosiped yo‘laklari bo‘yicha (2019).

title: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD), 11th Edition
abs: US national standard for traffic signs, signals and pavement markings. The 11th edition was published on 19 December 2023 (effective 18 January 2024) as the first major update in 14 years; FHWA has since issued Revision 1 (December 2025). Available free as PDF.

uz.t: AQSh: Harakatni boshqarish vositalari bo‘yicha yagona qo‘llanma (MUTCD), 11-nashr
uz.ab: AQShda yo‘l belgilari, svetoforlar va yo‘l chiziqlari bo‘yicha milliy standart. 11-nashr 2023-yil 19-dekabrda chiqqan (2024-yil 18-yanvardan amalda) — 14 yildagi birinchi yirik yangilanish; 2025-yil dekabrida 1-tahrir qo‘shilgan. PDF shaklida bepul.

title: СП 34.13330.2021 «Автомобильные дороги» (актуализированная редакция СНиП 2.05.02-85*)
abs: Rossiyada aholi punktlaridan tashqaridagi umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash qoidalari to‘plami; 2021-yil 9-fevralda tasdiqlangan, ishlab chiquvchi — MADI. SNiP 2.05.02-85 ning yangilangan tahriri; O‘zbekiston normalari bilan taqqoslash uchun muhim.

uz.t: SP 34.13330.2021 “Avtomobil yo‘llari” (SNiP 2.05.02-85* ning yangilangan tahriri)
uz.ab: Rossiyada aholi punktlaridan tashqaridagi umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llarni loyihalash me’yorlari; 2021-yilda tasdiqlangan, ishlab chiquvchi — MADI.

title: JTG B01-2014 Technical Standard of Highway Engineering (公路工程技术标准)
authors: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China
abs: China's basic industry standard for highway engineering, issued 30 September 2014 and in force since 1 January 2015, replacing JTG B01-2003. Applies to new, reconstructed and expanded highways. The linked Ministry of Transport document lists the current JTG standard system, headed by JTG B01-2014; the Chinese text is public, official English editions are sold separately.

uz.t: Xitoy: JTG B01-2014 Avtomobil yo‘llari muhandisligi texnik standarti
uz.ab: Xitoyda avtomobil yo‘llari muhandisligining asosiy tarmoq standarti; 2014-yil 30-sentabrda chiqarilgan, 2015-yil 1-yanvardan amalda. Havola Xitoy Transport vazirligining amaldagi JTG standartlar ro‘yxatiga olib boradi.

title: RAA — Guidelines for the Design of Motorways, Edition 2008 (English translation 2011)
abs: German guidelines for the design of motorways (Richtlinien für die Anlage von Autobahnen, RAA), introduced federally by circular ARS 7/2009. FGSV provides the official English translation free of charge.

uz.t: Germaniya: Avtomagistrallarni loyihalash bo‘yicha yo‘riqnoma (RAA, 2008)
uz.ab: Germaniyada avtomagistrallarni loyihalash qoidalari; federal darajada 2009-yilda joriy etilgan. FGSV rasmiy inglizcha tarjimasini bepul taqdim etadi.

title: СП РК 3.03-101-2013 «Автомобильные дороги» (с изменениями от 25.02.2019)
authors: Комитет по делам строительства и ЖКХ РК
abs: Qozog‘istonda avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash qoidalari to‘plami: SN RK 3.03-01-2013 ning majburiy talablarini bajarish uchun maqbul yechimlarni tavsiflaydi. Qo‘shni davlat bilan transport yo‘laklarini loyihalashda taqqoslash uchun foydali.

uz.t: Qozog‘iston: SP RK 3.03-101-2013 “Avtomobil yo‘llari”
uz.ab: Qozog‘istonda avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash qoidalari to‘plami (2019-yilgi o‘zgarishlar bilan).

title: СН РК 3.03-04-2014 «Проектирование дорожных одежд нежесткого типа»
authors: Комитет по делам строительства и ЖКХ РК

abs: Repairing roadside crash cushions after impacts exposes maintenance crews to live traffic. This project developed a self-restoring cushion that absorbs energy through a rotating drum, nylon strap and band brakes, then resets itself with a motorised winch, controller and sensors that also report crashes. Bench and bogie tests at 10–30 mph confirmed the concept, with higher brake pressure markedly increasing energy absorption; full MASH crash testing is still required.
title: Safer Cushions

abs: Early hairline cracks in new bridge decks are often missed by visual inspection, letting water and chlorides reach the reinforcement before preservation is scheduled. The project combined air-launched ground-penetrating radar (dielectric/moisture readings) with high-speed imaging and AI crack mapping into a single vulnerability index with colour-coded risk maps. Data from 23 bridges in four US states were collected and results for six bridges are reported, showing that high crack density largely coincides with higher moisture readings.
title: Establishing NDE Protocols for Use in Early Age Bridge Deck Preservation Strategies

title: Development of an Automated and Rapid Conditioning and Testing Device for Cracking and Rutting
abs: The project built AMAZE, a robot-based system that automates air-void measurement, temperature conditioning and IDEAL cracking and rutting tests of asphalt specimens for quality control. Its results were reported to be very close to those obtained by a lab technician.

uz.ab: Loyihada asfalt namunalarining g‘ovakligini o‘lchash, haroratda tayyorlash va IDEAL yoriq/iz sinovlarini robot yordamida avtomatik bajaruvchi AMAZE tizimi yaratildi. Natijalar laborant bajargan sinovlarga juda yaqin chiqdi. O‘zbekiston yo‘l laboratoriyalarida sifat nazorati sinovlarini tezlashtirish va inson xatosini kamaytirish uchun foydali.

title: An Automated System for Larger-Scale Intersection Marking Data Collection and Condition Assessment
abs: A web-based tool locates intersections from GIS data, retrieves aerial imagery and uses deep learning to detect lane-use arrows and crosswalks and rate their condition. Detection precision was roughly 85-89% and condition rating accuracy 83-91%.

uz.t: Chorrahalar yo‘l chiziqlari ma’lumotlarini keng miqyosda avtomatik yig‘ish va baholash tizimi
uz.ab: Veb-tizim GIS ma’lumotlari asosida chorrahalarni topib, aerofotosuratlardan chuqur o‘qitish yordamida yo‘nalish strelkalari va piyoda o‘tish joylarini aniqlaydi va ularning holatini baholaydi. Aniqlash aniqligi taxminan 85–89% bo‘ldi. O‘zbekistonda shahar yo‘l chiziqlarini joyga chiqmasdan inventarizatsiya qilish va ta’mirni rejalashtirishga yordam beradi.

title: A Smart IOT Proximity Alert System for Highway Work Zone Safety
abs: A wearable Bluetooth proximity alarm for road workers, paired with beacons on equipment and cloud logging, was developed and field tested. It gave about 2.2 seconds of reaction time, though the worker's body could block the signal, so several devices per vest were suggested.

uz.t: Yo‘l ish zonalari xavfsizligi uchun aqlli IoT yaqinlashish ogohlantirish tizimi
uz.ab: Yo‘l ishchilari uchun kiyiladigan Bluetooth yaqinlashish signal qurilmasi va texnikaga o‘rnatiladigan mayoqchalar ishlab chiqilib, dalada sinaldi. Tizim taxminan 2,2 soniya reaksiya vaqti berdi, ammo ishchi tanasi signalni to‘sib qo‘yishi mumkinligi aniqlandi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l ta’mirlash joylarida ishchilarni texnika va transportdan himoya qilish uchun dolzarb.

title: A Retroreflective Road Lane Marking Tape 1,000X Brighter than Existing Technology
abs: Prototype marking stripes combining a light-turning prismatic film with cube-corner sheeting were made, lab-certified and installed in two test sections in North Carolina and Texas. The best prototype reached about 29,000 mcd/m²/lx versus roughly 800 for a common commercial tape.

Eng yaxshi namuna oddiy tijorat lentasidan o‘nlab marta yuqori nur qaytaruvchanlik ko‘rsatdi. O‘zbekiston yo‘llarida tungi ko‘rinishni yaxshilash va YTHni kamaytirish uchun qiziqarli yechim.

title: Laboratory Dielectric Measurement System (LDMS) for Asphalt Mixture Bulk Specific Gravity Determination
abs: A standard lab procedure was developed to estimate the bulk specific gravity of compacted asphalt specimens from dielectric (GPR-type) readings. Three readings at 120-degree orientations proved repeatable, and the Hashin-Shtrikman model predicted density best, leading to a draft test specification.

uz.t: Asfalt aralashmasining hajmiy zichligini aniqlash uchun laboratoriya dielektrik o‘lchov tizimi
uz.ab: Zichlangan asfalt namunalarining hajmiy zichligini dielektrik (georadar turidagi) o‘lchovlar orqali aniqlash bo‘yicha laboratoriya usuli ishlab chiqildi. 120 gradusli uch o‘lchov takrorlanuvchan natija berdi va sinov standarti loyihasi tayyorlandi. O‘zbekistonda asfalt qatlamlarini zichlash sifatini buzmasdan tez nazorat qilishga xizmat qiladi.

title: Automated Data and Feature Extraction from Bridge Plans
abs: A deep-learning platform was built to pull dimensions, tables and text from bridge plan sets into spreadsheets, and it was tested on plans from Iowa and California DOTs. Most validation queries were extracted correctly when compared with manual extraction.

uz.t: Ko‘prik chizmalaridan ma’lumot va belgilarni avtomatik ajratib olish
uz.ab: Chuqur o‘qitishga asoslangan platforma ko‘prik chizmalaridan o‘lchamlar, jadvallar va matnlarni avtomatik ravishda jadvalga ko‘chiradi; u Ayova va Kaliforniya chizmalarida sinaldi. Tekshiruvda so‘rovlarning aksariyati to‘g‘ri ajratib olindi. O‘zbekistonda eski ko‘prik hujjatlarini raqamlashtirish va ko‘priklar bazasini yuritish uchun foydali.

title: AI Analyzer for Revealing Insights of Traffic Crashes
abs: An open-source tool applies a text classifier and an explainable-AI method to police crash narratives to find phrase groups linked to crash severity. It was demonstrated on MassDOT crash records, and the authors note the results are exploratory.

uz.t: YTH qonuniyatlarini ochib beruvchi AI analizator
uz.ab: Ochiq kodli vosita YTH bayonnomalaridagi matnlarni sun'iy intellekt yordamida tahlil qilib, og‘ir oqibatli hodisalar bilan bog‘liq iboralar guruhlarini aniqlaydi. U Massachusets ma’lumotlarida sinaldi, natijalar izlanish xarakterida ekani qayd etilgan. O‘zbekistonda YTH ma’lumotlaridan xavfli omillarni tezroq aniqlashga yordam berishi mumkin.

title: Measuring Concrete Permeability with the CHIP
abs: The X-ray based CHIP device was improved and used in three case studies to measure how fluids penetrate concrete, plus an accelerated version of the test was developed. Effects of delayed curing and silane sealers were measurable, and test time dropped from 28 days to about six hours.

uz.t: CHIP yordamida beton o‘tkazuvchanligini o‘lchash
uz.ab: Rentgen asosidagi CHIP qurilmasi takomillashtirilib, betonga suyuqlik singishini o‘lchash uchun uch amaliy holatda qo‘llandi va tezlashtirilgan sinov ishlab chiqildi. Silan qoplama ta’siri aniq o‘lchandi, sinov muddati 28 kundan taxminan 6 soatga qisqardi. O‘zbekistonda ko‘prik betonining chidamliligini tez baholash uchun ahamiyatli.

title: Development of an Innovative Bio-Mediated Self-Healing Concrete Technology
abs: Microcapsules containing fungi were added to mortar as a self-healing agent and evaluated in a proof-of-concept study. Cracks wider than 1 mm healed in the specimens, and the healed surface became strongly water-repellent.

uz.t: Biologik vositali o‘zini tiklovchi beton texnologiyasi
uz.ab: Zamburug‘ saqlovchi mikrokapsulalar qorishmaga o‘zini tiklovchi vosita sifatida qo‘shilib, dastlabki sinovdan o‘tkazildi. Namunalarda 1 mm dan keng yoriqlar bitdi va yuzasi suv o‘tkazmaydigan bo‘ldi. O‘zbekistonda beton inshootlarning xizmat muddatini uzaytirish va ta’mir xarajatini kamaytirish nuqtai nazaridan istiqbolli.

title: Field Test and Evaluation of a Solar Snow Fence
abs: A 25-foot sun-tracking solar snow fence that turns into a snow-fence position in strong winds was tested for 15 months beside I-80 in Wyoming. It produced 7.5-15 kWh per day and trapped drifting snow about as well as a nearby wooden fence without needing repairs.

uz.t: Quyosh panelli qordan himoya to‘sig‘ini dalada sinash va baholash
uz.ab: Quyoshni kuzatuvchi va kuchli shamolda qor to‘sig‘i holatiga o‘tuvchi 7,6 metrli quyosh panelli to‘siq Vayomingdagi I-80 yo‘li yonida 15 oy sinaldi. U kuniga 7,5–15 kVt·soat energiya berdi va qorni yog‘och to‘siq kabi samarali ushlab qoldi. O‘zbekistonning tog‘li dovonlarida qor uyumlariga qarshi kurash va energiya olishni birlashtirish uchun qiziqarli.

title: High Bond Steel Fibers for Ultra High-Performance Concrete (UHPC)
abs: A striated steel fiber for UHPC was developed and demonstrated in a bridge deck cast with an open-recipe UHPC mixed in a ready-mix truck. It increased pullout resistance by about 130% over smooth fiber, and a 1% dosage performed about as well as smooth fiber at 2%.

uz.t: O‘ta yuqori mustahkam beton (UHPC) uchun yuqori yopishqoqlikli po‘lat tolalar
uz.ab: UHPC uchun yuzasi qirrali po‘lat tola ishlab chiqilib, oddiy beton mikserida tayyorlangan ochiq retseptli UHPC bilan ko‘prik qoplamasida sinaldi. Tola sug‘urib olishga qarshilikni silliq tolaga nisbatan taxminan 130% oshirdi va kamroq miqdorda ham shunday samara berdi. O‘zbekistonda UHPC ni arzonroq qo‘llash imkonini beradi.

title: A Practical Method to Determine Reclaimed Asphalt Pavement (RAP) Binder Availability
abs: A washed sieve-analysis method was developed to estimate how much of the old binder in RAP actually becomes active, and it was tested on nine RAP sources from four states. Most sources had about 60% availability, and adjusting mix design for it generally improved cracking resistance without hurting rutting performance.

uz.t: Qayta ishlangan asfalt (RAP) bog‘lovchisining faol ulushini aniqlashning amaliy usuli
uz.ab: RAP tarkibidagi eski bitumning qancha qismi yangi aralashmada faol ishlashini aniqlash uchun yuvib elash usuli ishlab chiqildi va to‘rt shtatdagi to‘qqiz RAP manbasida sinaldi. Ko‘p manbalarda faol ulush taxminan 60% bo‘ldi, buni hisobga olgan loyiha yoriqbardoshlikni yaxshiladi. O‘zbekistonda eski asfaltni qayta ishlatishni ko‘paytirish va bitum tejash uchun bevosita foydali.

title: Stainless Steel Coated Rebar for Chloride Resistant Concrete Highways and Bridges
abs: Stainless-steel-clad rebar was developed, first by cold spraying and then by cladding a billet before hot rolling, and a 1,500 lb pilot batch was produced. Annealing was needed for the coating to bend, and the report claims roughly four times the corrosion resistance of standard rebar, with some coating breaches to be addressed.

uz.t: Xloridga chidamli beton yo‘l va ko‘priklar uchun zanglamaydigan po‘lat qoplamali armatura
uz.ab: Zanglamaydigan po‘lat bilan qoplangan armatura avval sovuq purkash, so‘ngra issiq prokatdan oldin zagotovkani qoplash usulida ishlab chiqildi va tajriba partiyasi tayyorlandi. Hisobotga ko‘ra korroziyaga chidamliligi oddiy armaturadan taxminan to‘rt barobar yuqori. O‘zbekistonda tuz va sho‘r tuproq ta’siridagi ko‘priklar uchun dolzarb.

title: Development of a Compaction Quality Control Standard for the Small Diameter Pressuremeter
abs: A fully automated control unit for the small-diameter SSMini pressuremeter and a draft compaction quality-control standard based on modulus and limit pressure were developed, backed by over 230 tests in Florida sands and Virginia clays. A Proctor-based acceptance chart combining moisture, density, saturation and modulus was proposed.

uz.t: Kichik diametrli pressiometr yordamida grunt zichlash sifatini nazorat qilish standartini ishlab chiqish
uz.ab: Kichik diametrli SSMini pressiometr uchun to‘liq avtomatik boshqaruv bloki va elastiklik moduli hamda chegaraviy bosimga asoslangan zichlash sifati standarti loyihasi ishlab chiqildi; 230 dan ortiq sinov qum va loy gruntlarda o‘tkazildi. Namlik, zichlik va modulni birlashtirgan qabul diagrammasi taklif qilindi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l to‘shamasi gruntini zichlashni tezkor nazorat qilish uchun amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

title: Safe and Inclusive Road Designs in Central Asia — Resource Package
abs: Resource package for road designers in Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan, prepared by IRF, iRAP, EASST and UNESCAP with United Nations Road Safety Fund support and launched at a Tashkent workshop in June 2025. It supplements, rather than replaces, national standards: it reviews the existing GOST/SNiP-based design standards of each country, sets out safety-led design solutions such as lower speeds and forgiving infrastructure, and includes an iRAP star rating assessment of standard cross sections. English and Russian versions are available.

uz.t: Markaziy Osiyoda xavfsiz va inklyuziv yo‘l loyihalari — resurslar to‘plami
uz.ab: Qirg‘iziston, Tojikiston va O‘zbekiston yo‘l loyihachilari uchun IRF, iRAP, EASST va UNESCAP tayyorlagan to‘plam; BMT Yo‘l xavfsizligi jamg‘armasi ko‘magida, 2025-yil iyunda Toshkentdagi yakuniy seminarda taqdim etilgan. To‘plam milliy me’yorlarni almashtirmaydi, to‘ldiradi: har bir davlatning GOST/SNiP asosidagi loyihalash me’yorlari tahlil qilinadi, tezlikni pasaytirish va «kechirimli» infratuzilma kabi yechimlar beriladi, tipik ko‘ndalang kesimlar iRAP yulduzli bahosi bilan baholanadi. Ingliz va rus tillarida. O‘zbekiston yo‘llarini loyihalashda bevosita qo‘llanadi.

title: Uzbekistan — Road Safety Design Guidance for Road Infrastructure Designers in Central Asia (English)
abs: Country guidance for Uzbekistan from the Central Asia safe and inclusive road design project. It is written for road infrastructure designers and sets out how evidence-based safety measures can be built into design decisions alongside the national standards in force.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston — yo‘l infratuzilmasi loyihachilari uchun yo‘l xavfsizligi bo‘yicha qo‘llanma (ingliz tilida)
uz.ab: Markaziy Osiyo loyihasi doirasida aynan O‘zbekiston uchun tayyorlangan qo‘llanma. Yo‘l infratuzilmasi loyihachilariga mo‘ljallangan: amaldagi milliy me’yorlar bilan birga xalqaro tajribaga asoslangan xavfsizlik choralarini loyiha qarorlariga qanday kiritish ko‘rsatilgan.

title: Uzbekistan — Road Safety Design Guidance for Road Infrastructure Designers in Central Asia (Russian)
abs: Ruscha nashri: Markaziy Osiyoda xavfsiz va inklyuziv yo‘l loyihalash bo‘yicha O‘zbekiston uchun qo‘llanma. Mamlakatimiz mutaxassislari uchun ishchi til sifatida qulay.

title: Policies to Extend the Life of Road Assets
abs: ITF Research Report prepared by a working group chaired by Rijkswaterstaat (Netherlands) with expert input from 17 countries. It examines what road administrations can do, in policy and in practice, to extend the service life of road assets, and treats road data itself as an asset in provision decisions.

uz.t: Yo‘l aktivlari xizmat muddatini uzaytirish siyosati
uz.ab: ITF ning 17 davlat mutaxassislari ishtirokidagi ishchi guruhi hisoboti (rais — Niderlandiya Rijkswaterstaat tashkiloti). Yo‘l tashkilotlari aktivlarning xizmat muddatini uzaytirish uchun qanday siyosiy va amaliy qarorlar qabul qilishi tahlil qilingan; yo‘l haqidagi ma’lumotlarning o‘zi ham aktiv sifatida ko‘riladi. O‘zbekistonda cheklangan ta’mir mablag‘ini taqsimlashda foydali.

title: Asset Management for the Roads Sector
abs: Report of the OECD Road Transport and Intermodal Linkage research programme working group on asset management. It defines asset management for road administrations, documents how far member countries had implemented it, and sets out the data collection and management such systems require.

uz.t: Yo‘l sohasida aktivlarni boshqarish
uz.ab: OECD ning yo‘l transporti tadqiqot dasturi ishchi guruhi hisoboti. Yo‘l tashkilotlari uchun aktivlarni boshqarish tushunchasi aniqlanadi, a’zo davlatlarda uning joriy etilish darajasi yoritiladi hamda bunday tizim uchun qanday ma’lumot yig‘ilishi va qanday boshqarilishi kerakligi ko‘rsatiladi. Yo‘l tarmog‘i reyestrini yuritishda uslubiy asos bo‘ladi.

title: CERCOM — Circular Economy in Road Construction and Maintenance: Case studies I & II, protocol and results
abs: Deliverable of the CERCOM project under the CEDR Transnational Road Research Programme. It sets out the protocol for selecting case studies of circular practice in road construction and maintenance and reports the results, including the method used for economic life-cycle assessment of pavement maintenance.

uz.t: CERCOM — yo‘l qurilishi va saqlashda sirkulyar iqtisodiyot: amaliy misollar protokoli va natijalari
uz.ab: CEDR xalqaro yo‘l tadqiqotlari dasturi doirasidagi CERCOM loyihasi hisoboti. Yo‘l qurilishi va saqlashda materialni qayta ishlatish bo‘yicha amaliy misollarni tanlash tartibi va natijalari, shu jumladan qoplama ta’mirining iqtisodiy hayotiy sikl tahlili usuli keltirilgan. Materiallarni qayta ishlatish bo‘yicha bizdagi tajribalar uchun uslubiy namuna.

title: CERCOM — Analysis of case studies: best practice approach
abs: Companion CERCOM deliverable analysing the collected case studies. It reviews the technical, social and risk indicators European national road authorities use across the pavement life cycle, the data they collect, and how a risk-based assessment framework can be applied in procurement.

uz.t: CERCOM — amaliy misollar tahlili: ilg‘or tajriba yondashuvi
uz.ab: CERCOM loyihasining ikkinchi hisoboti. Yevropa milliy yo‘l tashkilotlari qoplamaning butun hayotiy sikli davomida qanday texnik, ijtimoiy va risk ko‘rsatkichlaridan foydalanishi, qanday ma’lumot yig‘ishi va xaridda riskka asoslangan baholash tizimi qanday qo‘llanishi tahlil qilingan.

title: ERTRAC Roadmap: Circular Economy and Competitiveness of the European Road Transport
abs: ERTRAC roadmap setting out the research and innovation priorities that the European road transport sector sees for circularity and competitiveness.

uz.t: ERTRAC yo‘l xaritasi: sirkulyar iqtisodiyot va Yevropa yo‘l transportining raqobatbardoshligi
uz.ab: Yevropa yo‘l transporti texnologiya platformasi ERTRAC ning yo‘l xaritasi: resurslarni qayta ishlatish va raqobatbardoshlik bo‘yicha ilmiy-tadqiqot ustuvorliklari belgilangan. Tadqiqot yo‘nalishlarini rejalashtirishda qiyosiy manba.

title: ERTRAC Safe Road Transport Research Roadmap
abs: ERTRAC roadmap on road safety research, identifying the research needs European stakeholders set for reaching the EU's casualty reduction goals.

uz.t: ERTRAC xavfsiz yo‘l transporti bo‘yicha tadqiqot yo‘l xaritasi
uz.ab: ERTRAC ning yo‘l xavfsizligi tadqiqotlari bo‘yicha yo‘l xaritasi: Yevropa Ittifoqining qurbonlarni kamaytirish maqsadlariga erishish uchun qanday ilmiy tadqiqotlar zarurligi belgilangan.

title: ERTRAC Safety Paper 2023
abs: ERTRAC position paper on road transport safety research, updating the platform's view of priorities after its 2021 safety roadmap.

uz.t: ERTRAC 2023-yilgi xavfsizlik hujjati
uz.ab: ERTRAC ning yo‘l transporti xavfsizligi tadqiqotlari bo‘yicha pozitsion hujjati: 2021-yilgi yo‘l xaritasidan keyingi yangilangan ustuvorliklar.

title: Paving the way for Infrastructure and Long Distance Freight Transport cooperation
abs: ERTRAC deep-dive paper on how road infrastructure work and long-distance freight transport research can be brought closer together in Europe.

uz.t: Infratuzilma va uzoq masofali yuk tashish hamkorligiga yo‘l ochish
uz.ab: ERTRAC ning chuqurlashtirilgan tahlili: Yevropada yo‘l infratuzilmasi va uzoq masofali yuk tashish tadqiqotlarini qanday birlashtirish mumkinligi ko‘rib chiqilgan. Transport yo‘laklari rivojlanayotgan O‘zbekiston uchun ham dolzarb.

title: Transport Infrastructure Innovation Roadmap
authors: Joint ETP Task Force (ERTRAC, ERRAC, WATERBORNE, ACARE, ECTP)
abs: Joint European technology platform roadmap on innovation in transport infrastructure, covering construction, maintenance and the research agenda shared across transport modes.

uz.t: Transport infratuzilmasi innovatsiyalari yo‘l xaritasi
uz.ab: Yevropa texnologiya platformalarining birgalikdagi yo‘l xaritasi: transport infratuzilmasidagi innovatsiyalar, qurilish va saqlash texnologiyalari hamda umumiy tadqiqot kun tartibi.

title: RESKILLING — Reskilling the mobility workforce for Connected, Cooperative and Automated Mobility
abs: Horizon Europe project (GA 101147328, 2025–2027) led with FEHRL participation. It analyses how connected, cooperative and automated mobility changes road-sector professions and what skills the workforce will need, using a social innovation approach.

uz.t: RESKILLING — bog‘langan va avtomatlashtirilgan harakat uchun kadrlarni qayta tayyorlash
uz.ab: FEHRL ishtirokidagi Horizon Europe loyihasi (2025–2027). Bog‘langan, kooperativ va avtomatlashtirilgan harakat yo‘l sohasidagi kasblarni qanday o‘zgartirayotgani va mutaxassislarga qanday yangi malakalar kerakligi o‘rganilmoqda. Kadrlar tayyorlash dasturlarini yangilashda foydali.

title: Biomimetic Antifreeze Molecules: A Novel Solution to Deicing Salts and Air-Entraining Admixtures
abs: IDEA Project 204 synthesized and tested low-cost, non-toxic, biodegradable antifreeze biopolymers that mimic the natural antifreeze proteins of fish, plants and insects. At very low concentrations the molecules inhibited ice recrystallization, and freeze-thaw testing showed BAM-modified cement paste and concrete stayed freeze-thaw resistant with minimal entrained air; the molecules did not, however, melt ice already formed on surfaces.

uz.t: Biomimetik antifriz molekulalari: tuzlar va havo tortuvchi qo‘shimchalarga yangicha yechim
uz.ab: Baliq va o‘simliklarning tabiiy antifriz oqsillariga taqlid qiluvchi arzon, zaharsiz biopolimerlar sintez qilinib sinovdan o‘tkazilgan. Juda past konsentratsiyada ular muz qayta kristallanishini to‘xtatadi; bunday qo‘shimchali beton havo tortuvchi qo‘shimchasiz ham muzlash-erishga chidamli bo‘lib chiqqan. O‘zbekiston sharoitida qishda tuz sepishni kamaytirish va beton chidamliligini oshirish yo‘nalishidagi izlanishlar uchun qiziqarli manba.

title: MILDGLASS: GFRP Strand for Resilient Mild Pre-Stressed Concrete
abs: IDEA Project 207 developed and tested a glass-FRP strand for mild prestressing of concrete as a corrosion-resistant, lower-cost alternative where steel corrodes — coastal substructures, sheet piles and structures exposed to de-icing salts. The vinyl-ester GFRP strand was characterized for pull strength under instantaneous and sustained load, pseudo-creep and anchor-setting losses, and was applied in the field on a Florida bridge.

uz.t: MILDGLASS: oldindan zo‘riqtirilgan beton uchun korroziyabardosh shishatolali (GFRP) kanat
uz.ab: Po‘lat korroziyasi muammosiga qarshi shishatolali kompozit kanat ishlab chiqilib, uzilish kuchi, sudralish va ankerdagi yo‘qotishlar bo‘yicha sinalgan, Florida shtatidagi ko‘prikda amalda qo‘llangan. Tuz sepiladigan va namlik yuqori sharoitlarda ko‘prik elementlarining xizmat muddatini uzaytirish bo‘yicha bizning soha uchun ham dolzarb yo‘nalish.

title: Reducing Stormwater Runoff with Biochar Addition to Roadway Soils
abs: IDEA Project 211 (Type II) tested whether amending roadway soils with wood-based biochar cuts stormwater runoff by improving water retention and infiltration, so existing green verges work as stormwater treatment without new infrastructure. Twelve roadway soils from four state DOTs were studied over time; in field tests biochar's infiltration benefit was more than double that measured in the laboratory, though soils that already drained well saw little gain.

uz.t: Yo‘l gruntiga bioko‘mir qo‘shib yomg‘ir oqimini kamaytirish
uz.ab: Yo‘l yoqasidagi gruntga yog‘och bioko‘miri qo‘shilsa, suv shimilishi yaxshilanib, yomg‘ir oqimi sezilarli kamayishi 4 shtatdan olingan 12 xil gruntda sinab ko‘rilgan. Dala sinovlarida samara laboratoriyadagidan ikki baravar yuqori chiqqan. Yangi inshoot qurmasdan drenaj muammosini yumshatish — arzon va ekologik yechim sifatida e’tiborga molik.

title: Development of Three Point Bending Cylinder (3PBC) Asphalt Mixture Fatigue Test System
abs: IDEA Project 218 refined the three-point bending cylinder (3PBC) fatigue test for asphalt mixtures, developed because standard fatigue tests are long, costly and material-hungry. The 3PBC rig is inexpensive, uses ordinary cylindrical specimens and shortens preparation and testing time; the project improved the fixture's robustness and analysis methodology, and the method has since been standardized as ASTM D8458-22.

uz.t: Asfalt aralashmasi charchashini sinash uchun uch nuqtali egiluvchi silindr (3PBC) tizimi
uz.ab: An’anaviy charchash sinovlari uzoq va qimmat bo‘lgani uchun oddiy silindrik namunada ishlaydigan arzon 3PBC uskunasi yaratilgan: tayyorlash va sinash vaqti ancha qisqa. Usul keyinchalik ASTM D8458-22 standarti sifatida qabul qilingan. Institut laboratoriyasida asfaltbeton charchashini baholashni yo‘lga qo‘yish uchun qulay boshlang‘ich nuqta.

title: A Novel Durable, Healable, and Conveniently Removable Pavement Marking Material
abs: IDEA Project 219 developed a vitrimer-based two-part epoxy pavement marking that self-heals micro-cuts at elevated temperature and can be removed selectively with a mild acidic solution, so one material serves both permanent and temporary (work-zone) marking without damaging the surface at removal. Field sections were placed on the NDSU campus and at MnROAD, and the formulation priced out cheaper than commercial temporary marking products in its dual role.

uz.t: Mustahkam, o‘z-o‘zini tiklaydigan va oson ko‘chiriladigan yo‘l chizig‘i materiali
uz.ab: Vitrimer asosidagi ikki komponentli epoksid chiziq materiali mikro-yoriqlarini qizdirilganda o‘zi «davolaydi», kuchsiz kislotali eritma bilan esa qoplamani buzmasdan ko‘chiriladi — doimiy va vaqtinchalik (ta’mir zonasi) belgilar uchun bitta material. MnROAD poligonida dala sinovidan o‘tgan. Ta’mir ko‘p bo‘ladigan yo‘llarimizda vaqtinchalik chiziqlar muammosiga qiziqarli yechim.

title: Simple and Rapid Tests for Assessing Quality and Consistency of Reclaimed Asphalt Pavement (RAP) for Recycled Asphalt Mixture Applications
abs: IDEA Project 245 developed simple performance-based tests to estimate the performance grade (PG) of the binder in reclaimed asphalt pavement and to track RAP stockpile variability without solvent extraction and recovery, avoiding hazardous solvents such as trichloroethylene. Candidate tests including IDEAL-CT, HT-IDT, the Dongre workability test and impact resonance were evaluated on artificial and field RAP, and the framework offers an alternative to traditional extraction for quality control as RAP contents rise.

uz.t: Qayta ishlangan asfalt (RAP) sifati va bir xilligini baholash uchun sodda va tezkor sinovlar
uz.ab: RAP tarkibidagi bitumning PG markasini zaharli erituvchilarsiz (ekstraksiyasiz) baholash va uyum bir xilligini nazorat qilish uchun IDEAL-CT, HT-IDT kabi tezkor sinovlarga asoslangan usul taklif etilgan. RAP ulushi oshgani sari sifat nazorati uchun bu yondashuv laboratoriyamizga bevosita tatbiq etsa bo‘ladigan amaliy natija.

title: Develop a Method for Selecting Low-Energy Mixing and Compaction Temperatures for Asphalt Mixtures Considering Asphalt Lubrication and Aggregate Characteristics
abs: IDEA Project 246 brought tribology into asphalt practice: it built a tribological test rig and protocol for the lubricating ability of asphalt binders, linked lubrication to mixture workability, and proposed a method for setting mixing and compaction temperatures that accounts for aggregate characteristics rather than binder viscosity alone. The aim is lower production temperatures and energy use while improving density and pavement performance over methods such as ASTM D2493.

uz.t: Asfalt moylash xossasi va tosh materiali xususiyatlarini hisobga olib kam energiyali aralashtirish va zichlash haroratini tanlash usuli
uz.ab: Bitumning «moylash» qobiliyatini o‘lchaydigan tribologik sinov yaratilib, aralashma ishlovchanligi shu orqali tushuntirilgan; aralashtirish-zichlash haroratini faqat qovushqoqlik bo‘yicha emas, tosh materiali xususiyatlarini ham hisobga olib tanlash usuli taklif etilgan. Bu asfalt zavodlarida haroratni pasaytirib energiya va bitum qarishini tejashga yo‘l ochadi.

title: Enhanced Network-level Curve Safety Assessment and Monitoring Using Low-cost Mobile Devices — Refinement and Field Evaluation
abs: IDEA Project 248 refined a smartphone-based framework that uses built-in GPS and IMU sensors to assess horizontal-curve advisory speeds at network level, as a low-cost alternative to ball-bank indicator runs. Horizontal curves are about five percent of highway miles but account for nearly a quarter of fatal crashes; edge computing on the phone delivers advisory-speed results immediately on exiting each curve, and field evaluation covered accuracy and repeatability across vehicles and drivers.

uz.t: Arzon mobil qurilmalar yordamida egri uchastkalar xavfsizligini tarmoq miqyosida baholash va kuzatish
uz.ab: Oddiy smartfonning GPS va IMU sensorlari orqali gorizontal egri uchastkalarda tavsiya etiladigan tezlikni avtomatik aniqlaydigan tizim takomillashtirilib, dalada turli avtomobil va haydovchilar bilan sinalgan. Egri uchastkalar yo‘lning ~5 foizini tashkil etsa-da, halokatli YTHlarning chorak qismi shu yerda sodir bo‘ladi. Qimmat asbob-uskunasiz butun tarmoqni tekshirish imkonini beradi — respublika yo‘llari uchun juda amaliy yechim.

title: Bridges to the Future: Training Inspectors with Simulation-Based Interactive Storytelling
abs: IDEA Project 260 addressed the retirement-driven gap in bridge construction inspection workforces: it built a simulation-based interactive-storytelling training platform whose branching scenarios encode the tacit knowledge of senior Kentucky Transportation Cabinet inspectors, delivered including on an AR headset. In a controlled trial with 59 students the simulation group scored significantly higher than classroom-trained peers and rated the training more positively on most survey items.

uz.t: Kelajak ko‘priklari: inspektorlarni simulyatsiyaga asoslangan interaktiv hikoyalar bilan o‘qitish
uz.ab: Tajribali ko‘prik inspektorlarining bilimi tarmoqlanuvchi stsenariylarga aylantirilib, simulyatsiya-trenajyor yaratilgan; nazorat guruhli tajribada simulyatsiyada o‘qiganlar an’anaviy darsda o‘qiganlardan yuqori natija ko‘rsatgan. Tajribali kadrlar yetishmovchiligi sharoitida yosh mutaxassislarni tezroq tayyorlash usuli sifatida institut uchun ham ibratli.

title: New IDEAs for Highway Systems: Highway IDEA Program Annual Report 2024
abs: Annual progress report of the NCHRP Highway IDEA program (December 2024), summarizing the active and completed exploratory innovation projects of the program year across pavements, structures, safety, maintenance and monitoring. A single volume for scanning what is being piloted before full reports appear.

uz.t: Avtomobil yo‘llari uchun yangi G‘OYAlar: Highway IDEA dasturining 2024-yilgi hisoboti
uz.ab: NCHRP IDEA dasturining 2024-yil dekabrdagi yillik hisoboti: qoplamalar, inshootlar, xavfsizlik va saqlash bo‘yicha barcha faol va yakunlangan tajriba loyihalarining qisqacha bayoni bitta jildda. Qaysi texnologiyalar hali sinov bosqichida ekanini kuzatib borish uchun qulay manba.

title: ОДМ 218.6.025-2017 «Методические рекомендации по выбору эффективных некапиталоемких мероприятий по снижению аварийности в местах концентрации ДТП на автомобильных дорогах общего пользования»
abs: Отраслевой методический документ Росавтодора (распоряжение № 2362-р от 31.08.2017), разработанный РОСДОРНИИ. Описывает выбор и приоритизацию недорогих мер, выполняемых при содержании и ремонте дорог, для устранения мест концентрации ДТП, их технико-экономическое обоснование и оценку эффективности методом «до/после».

uz.t: ODM 218.6.025-2017: YTH to‘planish joylarida avariyalarni kamaytirish bo‘yicha kam xarajatli tadbirlarni tanlash uslubiy tavsiyalari
uz.ab: Rosavtodor tomonidan 2017-yilda tavsiya etilgan uslubiy hujjat: avariya o‘choqlarini tahlil qilish, saqlash va ta’mirlash doirasidagi arzon tadbirlarni tanlash, ularni iqtisodiy asoslash va samaradorligini “oldin/keyin” usulida baholash. O‘zbekistonda avariya o‘choqlarini bartaraf etish dasturlari uchun tayyor metodika sifatida qo‘llash mumkin.

title: ОДМ 218.2.007-2011 «Методические рекомендации по проектированию мероприятий по обеспечению доступа инвалидов к объектам дорожного хозяйства»
abs: Рекомендации по проектированию элементов обустройства новых и реконструируемых дорог с учётом потребностей инвалидов и маломобильных групп населения: тротуары мостов, пешеходные мосты и переходы, площадки сервиса. Применён распоряжением Росавтодора № 758-р от 05.06.2013; документ носит рекомендательный характер.

uz.t: ODM 218.2.007-2011: Yo‘l xo‘jaligi obyektlarida nogironlar uchun qulay muhitni loyihalash bo‘yicha uslubiy tavsiyalar
uz.ab: Yangi va rekonstruksiya qilinadigan yo‘llarda piyoda yo‘laklari, ko‘priklar trotuarlari, piyodalar o‘tish joylari va servis maydonchalarini nogironlar hamda kam harakatchan guruhlar uchun qulay loyihalash tavsiyalari. O‘zbekistonda inklyuziv yo‘l infratuzilmasi talablarini ishlab chiqishda foydali namuna.

title: ОДМ 218.6.029-2017 «Рекомендации по установлению гарантийных сроков конструктивных элементов автомобильных дорог и технических средств организации дорожного движения»
abs: Отраслевой документ, рекомендованный к применению распоряжением Росавтодора № 4000-р от 15.12.2017 и направленный Минтрансом в регионы письмом от 15.02.2018. Устанавливает рекомендуемые гарантийные сроки для элементов дорог (покрытий, оснований, сооружений) и технических средств организации движения; на странице доступны текст и сопроводительные документы.

uz.t: ODM 218.6.029-2017: Avtomobil yo‘llari konstruktiv elementlari va harakatni tashkil etish vositalarining kafolat muddatlarini belgilash tavsiyalari
uz.ab: Rossiyada yo‘l qoplamalari, asoslar, inshootlar va harakatni tashkil etish texnik vositalari uchun tavsiya etilgan kafolat muddatlari. O‘zbekistonda pudratchilar bilan shartnomalarda kafolat majburiyatlarini belgilashda tayanch bo‘la oladi.

title: СП «Проектирование и строительство автомобильных дорог с низкой интенсивностью движения» (окончательная редакция, утв. приказом Минтранса России № 291 от 30.09.2015)
abs: Свод правил для региональных, межмуниципальных, местных и частных дорог IV–V категорий с интенсивностью не более 400 авт./сут. Заменяет для таких дорог отдельные положения СП 34.13330, СП 35.13330 и СП 78.13330; разработан РОСДОРНИИ. Ссылка ведёт на окончательную редакцию на сайте Минтранса.

uz.t: Rossiya qoidalar to‘plami: Kam harakat intensivligidagi avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash va qurish
uz.ab: Sutkasiga 400 tagacha avtomobil o‘tadigan IV–V toifali mahalliy va qishloq yo‘llarini soddalashtirilgan, tejamkor me’yorlar asosida loyihalash va qurish qoidalari. O‘zbekistonning keng qishloq yo‘llari tarmog‘ini arzonroq qurish va ta’mirlash uchun juda dolzarb.

title: СП 35.13330.2011 «Мосты и трубы» (актуализированная редакция СНиП 2.05.03-84*)
abs: Основной российский свод правил по проектированию мостов и водопропускных труб на автомобильных и железных дорогах, утверждён Минрегионом России 28.12.2010, разработчик — ЦНИИС. Ссылка ведёт на справочную карточку NormaCS со статусом документа.

uz.t: SP 35.13330.2011 “Ko‘priklar va quvurlar” (SNiP 2.05.03-84* yangilangan tahriri)
uz.ab: Avtomobil va temir yo‘llardagi ko‘priklar hamda suv o‘tkazuvchi quvurlarni loyihalashning asosiy Rossiya me’yorlari. O‘zbekistonda hanuz SNiP 2.05.03-84 an’analariga tayanilgani sababli, ko‘prik me’yorlarini yangilashda taqqoslash uchun muhim.

title: Технический регламент Таможенного союза ТР ТС 014/2011 «Безопасность автомобильных дорог»
abs: Технический регламент, принятый решением Комиссии Таможенного союза № 827 от 18.10.2011, устанавливает обязательные требования безопасности к дорогам общего пользования и дорожным сооружениям при проектировании, строительстве, реконструкции, капремонте и эксплуатации, а также к дорожно-строительным материалам. Текст размещён на сайте Минтранса России.

uz.t: Bojxona ittifoqi texnik reglamenti TR TS 014/2011 “Avtomobil yo‘llari xavfsizligi”
uz.ab: Yevroosiyo iqtisodiy ittifoqi doirasida umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llar, yo‘l inshootlari va yo‘l qurilish materiallariga qo‘yiladigan majburiy xavfsizlik talablari. O‘zbekiston YeOIIda kuzatuvchi bo‘lgani va mintaqada GOSTlar keng qo‘llanishi sababli bu reglament amaliy ahamiyatga ega.

title: Рекомендации по применению технического регламента Таможенного союза «Безопасность автомобильных дорог» (ТР ТС 014/2011)
abs: Добровольное руководство (Москва, 2014; окончательная редакция) по применению ТР ТС 014/2011 при изысканиях, проектировании, строительстве, ремонте и эксплуатации дорог и при подтверждении соответствия дорожно-строительных материалов. Адресовано изготовителям, проектным и строительным организациям, органам по сертификации, лабораториям и органам надзора.

uz.t: TR TS 014/2011 “Avtomobil yo‘llari xavfsizligi” texnik reglamentini qo‘llash bo‘yicha tavsiyalar
uz.ab: Reglament talablarini loyihalash, qurilish, ta’mirlash va foydalanishda hamda yo‘l materiallari muvofiqligini tasdiqlashda qanday qo‘llashni tushuntiruvchi qo‘llanma. O‘zbekiston laboratoriyalari va sertifikatlash organlari uchun foydali amaliy manba.

title: СТО АВТОДОР 7.1-2013 «Экологическая безопасность. Зелёный стандарт Государственной компании «Автодор»»
abs: Стандарт организации Госкомпании «Автодор», устанавливающий экологические требования к автомагистралям и объектам придорожного сервиса на всех стадиях жизненного цикла и порядок оценки соответствия. Предусматривает рейтинговую систему с уровнями от «зелёного» до «платинового».

uz.t: STO AVTODOR 7.1-2013: “Avtodor” davlat kompaniyasining “Yashil standarti” (ekologik xavfsizlik)
uz.ab: Avtomagistrallar va yo‘l bo‘yi servis obyektlarini loyihalash, qurish va ulardan foydalanishda ekologik talablar hamda reyting tizimi. O‘zbekistonda “yashil” yo‘l loyihalari va pullik magistrallar uchun ekologik mezonlar ishlab chiqishda namuna.

title: Системный подход к вопросам стандартизации в сфере дорожного хозяйства Российской Федерации
abs: Статья специалистов РОСДОРНИИ, применяющая системный анализ к нормативной базе дорожного хозяйства России: внешние факторы (законодательство, ТР ТС 014/2011), объекты и аспекты стандартизации по стадиям жизненного цикла. Авторы показывают, как такой анализ выявляет пробелы и устаревшие требования в межгосударственных и национальных стандартах.

uz.t: Rossiya Federatsiyasi yo‘l xo‘jaligida standartlashtirish masalalariga tizimli yondashuv
uz.ab: ROSDORNII mutaxassislarining maqolasi: yo‘l sohasidagi me’yoriy hujjatlar tizimini “qora quti” usulida tahlil qilib, yetishmayotgan va eskirgan talablarni aniqlash yo‘llari ko‘rsatilgan. O‘zbekiston yo‘l me’yorlarini inventarizatsiya qilish va yangilash ishlari uchun metodik yordam beradi.

title: 交通工程设施（公路）标准体系（2023年） — Highway Traffic Engineering Facilities Standard System (2023)
authors: 全国交通工程设施（公路）标准化技术委员会
abs: Framework table published on the Ministry of Transport portal that maps China's existing and planned standards for highway traffic engineering facilities. It groups them into basic, service, technical and product standards (materials, traffic facilities, bridge and tunnel structures, test equipment, machinery) and aims to remove outdated or overlapping standards.

uz.t: Xitoy: Avtomobil yo‘llari transport-muhandislik inshootlari standartlar tizimi (2023)
uz.ab: Xitoyda yo‘l belgilari, to‘siqlar, yoritish, sinov uskunalari va boshqa transport-muhandislik inshootlari bo‘yicha amaldagi va rejalashtirilgan standartlarning tizimli ro‘yxati. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l jihozlari standartlarini tartibga solish uchun tuzilma namunasi bo‘ladi.

title: JTG/T 4240—2024 公路路政勘查技术规范 — Technical Specification for Highway Asset Survey
authors: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China
abs: Chinese highway industry specification drafted by the MOT Research Institute of Highway. It sets requirements for on-site surveys after unauthorised occupation, excavation, damage, loss or pollution of highway assets, covering equipment, site protection, methods and records, for highways of all grades.

uz.t: Xitoy: JTG/T 4240-2024 Yo‘l mulkiga yetkazilgan zararni joyida tekshirish texnik qoidalari
uz.ab: Yo‘l mulki noqonuniy egallangan, buzilgan yoki ifloslantirilgan hollarda joyida tekshiruv o‘tkazish, uskunalar, usullar va hujjatlashtirish talablari. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l mulkini muhofaza qilish va zararni undirish tartibini takomillashtirishda foydali.

title: 现行公路工程行业标准（定额）及日常管理组信息 — Current Highway Engineering Industry Standards (Quotas) List (as of 10 Nov 2025)
authors: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China — Highway Bureau
abs: Directory published by the MOT Highway Bureau listing 174 highway engineering industry standards and cost quotas in force as of 10 November 2025, with numbers, titles, chief drafting units and management contacts. Covers general, safety/green/smart, survey and design, construction, supervision and cost, maintenance and operations standards.

uz.t: Xitoy: Amaldagi avtomobil yo‘llari muhandisligi tarmoq standartlari (normativlar) ro‘yxati (2025-yil 10-noyabr holatiga)
uz.ab: Xitoy Transport vazirligi Avtomobil yo‘llari boshqarmasining 174 ta amaldagi JTG standart va smeta normativlari ro‘yxati. O‘zbekiston mutaxassislari uchun Xitoy yo‘l me’yorlarining eng so‘nggi to‘liq ko‘rsatkichi.

title: 交通运输环境保护标准体系（2024年） — Transport Environmental Protection Standards System (2024)
authors: 交通运输环境保护标准化技术委员会
abs: Standards system catalogue on the MOT portal for transport environmental protection: energy saving and carbon reduction, air, water, noise and waste pollution control, recycling, ecological restoration and monitoring. It covers 6 national and 57 industry standards plus 50 related ones, with in-force, in-preparation and planned items.

uz.t: Xitoy: Transportda atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish standartlar tizimi (2024)
uz.ab: Transport sohasida energiya tejash, uglerod chiqindilarini kamaytirish, shovqin va ifloslanishni nazorat qilish hamda ekologik tiklash standartlari katalogi. O‘zbekiston yo‘l loyihalarida ekologik me’yorlarni shakllantirishda yo‘naltiruvchi manba.

title: 交通运输部关于印发《交通运输行业标准管理办法》的通知（交科技规〔2024〕1号） — Measures for the Administration of Transport Industry Standards
authors: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China
abs: MOT notice issued on 2 February 2024 (effective 1 March 2024) with the Measures governing project approval, drafting, review, approval, publication, implementation and periodic review of transport industry standards. It defines the roles of the ministry, standardisation bodies and technical committees.

uz.t: Xitoy: Transport tarmog‘i standartlarini boshqarish tartibi (2024)
uz.ab: Xitoyda transport tarmoq standartlarini rejalashtirish, ishlab chiqish, ekspertiza, tasdiqlash, nashr etish va qayta ko‘rib chiqish tartibi. O‘zbekistonda yo‘l me’yorlarini ishlab chiqish jarayonini tashkil etishda tajriba sifatida qiziq.

title: 公路“十四五”发展规划 — Highway Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan Period
authors: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China
abs: China's sector plan for highways for 2021–2025 with an outlook to 2035, published on the MOT portal. It reviews the state of the network and sets targets and tasks for expressways, trunk and rural roads, maintenance, network operation, services, innovation, safety, green development and governance.

uz.t: Xitoy: Avtomobil yo‘llarini “14-besh yillik” davrida rivojlantirish rejasi
uz.ab: 2021–2025-yillarga mo‘ljallangan (2035-yilgacha istiqbol bilan) Xitoy avtomobil yo‘llari tarmog‘ini rivojlantirish, saqlash, xavfsizlik va “yashil” rivojlanish maqsadlari. O‘zbekiston yo‘l sohasini rivojlantirish strategiyasini ishlab chiqishda solishtirma manba.

title: 交通运输安全应急标准体系（2022年） — Transport Safety and Emergency Standards System (2022)
authors: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China
abs: Standards system framework (December 2022) on the MOT portal covering transport safety and emergency response in seven areas, from terminology to construction and operation safety, passenger and freight safety, emergency management and equipment. Highway construction and maintenance safety, signs and markings, tunnel and road rescue standards form a large part.

uz.t: Xitoy: Transport xavfsizligi va favqulodda vaziyatlarga javob berish standartlar tizimi (2022)
uz.ab: Yo‘l qurilishi va saqlashdagi xavfsizlik, yo‘l belgilari, tunnellar va yo‘lda qutqaruv ishlari kabi yo‘nalishlarni qamrab olgan standartlar tizimi. O‘zbekistonda tog‘ yo‘llari va tunnellar xavfsizligi me’yorlarini ishlab chiqishda foydali.
